<b>Pristine Cores</b> are [[Items (Silksong)#Consumables|consumable items]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
Can be used from the inventory to gain {{S|220}}.


== How to Acquire ==
There are two <b>Pristine Cores</b> that can be obtained:

{| class="article-table" style="text-align: center;" width="100%" data-tpt-table-id="silksong-pristine-core"
! 
! Area
! Location
! Map
|-
! 1
| [[Underworks]]
| After purchasing all equipment from [[Twelfth Architect]] and obtaining the [[Architect's Melody]], speaking with it one last time and then sitting on a faraway [[Bench (Silksong)|bench]], upon returning it will be found dead. A Pristine Core will then be found on its corpse.
| [[File:Mapshot SS Twelfth Architect 01.png|center|200x200px]]
|-
! 2
| [[Cogwork Core]]
| Dropped by one of the two [[Cogwork Clapper]]s in their storage room arena during [[Act 3]], after defeating both.
| [[File:Mapshot SS Cogwork Clapper 02.png|center|200x200px]]
|}
